title: push-images promotion: gate promote-latest with a job-level if before its concurrency group, not inside a step
answers: Why can a pending latest-image promotion get dropped when a newer non-latest release finishes?
How do I add a serialized job to push-images without losing runs in its concurrency group?
Why is the Latest-release check a separate job from promote-latest?
Where is the promotion concurrency group defined?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/push-images.yml job check-latest (outputs promote) feeds job promote-latest, which is the only job that writes floating GHCR tags. promote-latest is serialized by concurrency group push-images-promote-latest.
Rule: GitHub keeps one running and one pending run per concurrency group, and a newly queued run replaces the pending one even with cancel-in-progress: false. So a run that will skip must not enter the group. Make the decision in a separate job that exposes an output, and gate the writing job with `if: needs.check-latest.outputs.promote == 'true'` at job level. Keep the in-job re-check before the writes.
Symptom: A pending canonical-latest promotion could be silently replaced by a later non-latest patch run. That later run then skipped, so no run promoted the canonical release and the floating tags stayed stale.
Constraints: The replacement behavior comes from a review comment, not from a test run. The check-latest job itself has no concurrency block, and the push-images job has none either.
applies: Any concurrency group in push-images.yml or a similar release workflow where some runs skip and others must not be dropped.
says: The latest container image tag points to an outdated release version.
Publishing a patch version caused the latest release container tag to stall.
Ensure floating image tags update reliably when multiple releases build at once.
Container registry latest tag was not updated after a new release finished.
search: In .github/workflows/push-images.yml, gate the promote-latest job at the job level using if: needs.check-latest.outputs.promote == 'true' before entering the push-images-promote-latest concurrency group. Because GitHub concurrency groups replace pending runs even when cancel-in-progress is false, skipping runs must be filtered out by an upstream check-latest job output rather than within a step. Applies to release concurrency groups writing floating GHCR tags where neither check-latest nor push-images has concurrency blocks.
